coverageGaps: The reported 168-unit planning count has not been reconciled to a named, versioned inventory.
No authoritative waterbody geometry or complete municipal/city crosswalk is validated; the reviewed national catchment dataset is planning context only.
Coastal, estuarine and brackish study-area identities remain incomplete.
Aurora, Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Pampanga, Tarlac and Zambales require additional source-reviewed fish records beyond the named leads.
Regional species coverage, historical/current distinctions, taxonomy, locality precision, rights and safety information remain incomplete.
The newly reviewed 2009 fish-name excerpts are aggregate across study sites; per-site tables, field dates, coordinates and item-specific reuse approval remain pending.

The 2025 North Luzon barcode paper spans Aurora, Cagayan and Zambales. Four GenBank endpoint records were spot-checked and expose only country-level location, not province or waterbody; supplementary rows remain held under the article's CC BY-NC-ND license.

The BFAR Bulacan profile adds 22 communal/inland waterbody name leads but no per-waterbody fish roster or geometry; Angat EMB monitoring station references are water-quality locations, not fish evidence, and report dates/methods remain unverified. The Angat Pterygoplichthys location is a secondary 2005 introduction-year lead, not an observation date or current record.

nextStep.action: Continue Central Luzon source discovery with locality-resolved Bulacan freshwater studies. Use the BFAR profile's 22 communal/inland features as a search checklist only, not a fish roster; the 2022 EMB RSOBER report indexes three Angat River water-quality stations, but its full methods and sample dates were inaccessible, so do not infer current safety or fish presence. The Angat River, Angat municipality Pterygoplichthys item remains only a 2005 introduction-year lead from a secondary 2025 table; the original 2014 proceedings are unavailable. Continue underlying Zambales/Aurora tables: Dibut's 22-versus-23 conflict and article reuse remain unresolved; the Masinloc-Oyon Bay FASPS report is login-gated. Agno ARB7 is one Paniqui station (10 taxa/137 sampled individuals) with wet/dry date mapping unresolved. Four GenBank spot checks were country-level only (four country-level GenBank checks); keep Cagayan in its own rollout phase, preserve separate Bataan river rows with no independent identity verification, and continue distinct river, lake, reservoir, wetland, brackish and coastal leads. Do not mark Central Luzon complete.
